items.statement: Engage the buyer by asking questions to understand their concerns better.
Buyers often push back when they feel uncertain or overwhelmed during the sales process.
I believe that shifting your mindset can significantly improve the way you handle objections.
I have seen personal growth by learning how to respond effectively to buyer objections.
Successful agents listen actively to buyer concerns before addressing them with solutions.

overview: A LinkedIn post discussing strategies to handle buyer pushbacks in sales.
